title: Release denials of the YaCy companion app
description: Peers do not trust page attestations of a denied release that are time-stamped from its deniedFrom time on. Attestations time-stamped before it stay trusted. Remove an entry to lift the denial.

signingCertificate.description: SHA-256 digest of the signing certificate of the release, as in its release-record.json: lowercase hex, or the colon-separated form that keytool writes.

deniedFrom.description: RFC 3339 time after 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z. Attestations time-stamped from this time on are not trusted.
